title: Horizontal Compression of a Cubic Polynomial
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Give an equation for the graph of y = 1 - x^3 after it is compressed horizontally by a factor of 3.

steps.title: Recall the Horizontal Compression Rule
steps.explanation: To compress the graph of y = f(x) horizontally by a factor of c > 1, replace x with c*x.
steps.why: Replacing x with c*x divides every x-coordinate by c.

steps.title: Substitute 3x for x in y = 1 - x^3
steps.explanation: With horizontal compression factor c = 3, replace x with 3x.

steps.title: Cube the Term 3x
steps.explanation: Since (3x)^3 = 3^3 * x^3 = 27x^3, the compressed equation is y = 1 - 27x^3 (compressing the x-intercept from (1, 0) to (1/3, 0)).
